label: Google Drive: Download
description: Downloads a Drive file into storage; Google-native files are exported (Docs/Slides as PDF, Sheets as CSV, or the mime you set). The file is swept when the run ends; wire it through KeepFile to keep it.

inputs.name: fileId
inputs.label: File id
inputs.placeholder: Pick a file, or paste its link

inputs.name: exportFormat
inputs.label: Export as (mime)
inputs.description: Google-native files only: export mime type. Empty = PDF for Docs/Slides, CSV for Sheets.
